note: s02 is a pre-io_uring tree (no fs/io_uring.c, no include/uapi/linux/io_uring.h, zero io_uring symbols) - branch target structurally absent. Adjacent mmap'd-ring plumbing audited under the same single-fetch invariant. Strongest candidate: tpacket_snd() in net/packet/af_packet.c reading the TX-ring-resident virtio_net_hdr (hdr_len) once inside __packet_snd_vnet_parse() and then independently re-reading vnet_hdr->hdr_len at line 2680 to size the skb; all other ring consumers (aio ring, perf user_page, vhost) use single READ_ONCE/local copies or clamped locals.

candidates.reason: lookup_ioctx: get_user(id,&ring->id) fetched once; same local id bounds-checked and used for table lookup.
aio_read_events_ring: head/tail read once into locals, normalized with %= ctx->nr_events before offset math.
refill_reqs_available explicitly clamps head modulo ctx->nr_events ('Clamp head since userland can write to it').
io_submit_one copies the whole iocb once with copy_from_user into a stack struct; all later uses come from the snapshot.
perf_output_begin: data_tail READ_ONCE into local tail used for the space check and never re-read.
perf_aux_output_begin: aux_tail READ_ONCE into local, used once in CIRC_SPACE.
vhost_get_vq_desc: ring_head fetched once into local, bounds-checked head >= vq->num, descriptor copy re-read via vhost_copy_from_user into local desc used consistently.

tpacket_snd: virtio_net_hdr lives in user-mapped TX ring; __packet_snd_vnet_parse validates hdr_len <= tp_len but line 2680 re-reads vnet_hdr->hdr_len from shared memory to compute copylen sizing sock_alloc_send_skb; line 2719 passes the same shared pointer to virtio_net_hdr_to_skb for a third fetch. Check-then-use double fetch on mmap'd ring memory.
